5.3.8.9       Replacing the DLG control PCB

                  This is the procedure to replace the DLG control PCB.

              1   Make sure that the linear accelerator is safe for Agility™ BLD maintenance.
              2   Open the DLG PCB cage.
              3   Remove the four Torx screws to remove the metal cover.
              4   Disconnect all six cables from the DLG control PCB.
                   a   Record the positions of the cable ties.
                 b   Cut the cable ties as necessary.
              5   Remove the four spacers to remove the PCB.
              6   Replace the DLG control PCB as a reversal of the removal procedure.
              7   Do a diagnostic test to make sure that the leafbank operates correctly.
              8   Prepare the linear accelerator for operation.

                Related Links:
              Making the linear accelerator safe for Agility™ BLD maintenance on page 101
               Doing the Agility™ MLC diagnostic tests on page 223
                Preparing the linear accelerator for operation after Agility™ BLD maintenance on page 102

6.1.3      Log File Display tab

                  This is a description of the Log File Display tab.
              The Log File Display tab lets you see the log files for the linear accelerator. This is the same utility
                 that is available in Service Mode, which shows the life and event logs made during the operation
                 of the machine.





                                                                                                                                                                          012883_001
                   Figure 6.7     Log File Display tab of the Diagnostic Utility

               Log file Sorting
                 This lets you put the log files in for machine state changes in sequence (for example, suspends,
                  interrupts, and terminated treatments). This lets you find a problem more easily.

              Date Filter
                        It is possible to set a filter to show only the log files that were saved between two dates. Be
                  careful when you type the date. Elekta recommends that you use a three letter abbreviation for
                the month, for example, ‘10 Nov 11’. Also, Elekta recommends that you set filters for dates,
               because some time is necessary for 999 log files to load (the maximum available).

               Other Information
              You can look at the calibration files, energy calibration files, linac terminations, and HT Hours/Life
                Dose. The energy calibration files show the saved values for a given energy. The calibration files
             do not give much information for the field engineer. The Linac Terminations filter shows all the
                 log files for suspends and terminated treatments. HT Hours/Life Dose gives information on the
               dose delivered during the life of the machine.

     Note:    When there are 999 log files, some time is necessary before the system can show the terminated
                treatments only.

6.2        Agility™ MLC drive checks

6.2.1      Doing the leaf drive current check

              7   Monitor the image and make sure that all the leaves move to the correct position.
              8    Click on the Service Graphing icon.
              9    Select Files.

              7    Select Axis tab.
